blocks.en: Output: Qwen3-8B SFT Thinking trace (excerpt): I started from the observation that LoRA already provides a strong structural handle on adaptation: it freezes the backbone and learns a low-rank update, so any safety intervention can be inserted directly into that update space rather than into full fine-tuning @hu2022lora. The limitation is that the update space is unconstrained, and prior safety work had already shown that even benign downstream adaptation can degrade alignment @qi2024finetuning. SafeLoRA addressed this by projecting the LoRA update into a safety-aligned subspace using a reference model @hsu2024safelora, but its projection is a hard constraint that can suppress task learning. SaLoRA improved that formulation by replacing the safety subspace with a null space, which preserves more task capacity @li2025salora, yet it stil […] Proposal: [Motivation] Fine-tuning aligned large language models with LoRA is attractive because it preserves the backbone and keeps adaptation lightweight, but recent evidence shows that this efficiency comes with a safety cost. Even benign downstream adaptation can degrade safety alignment, indicating that the LoRA update space can drift in harmful directions during optimization @qi2024finetuning. Existing safety-aware LoRA methods address this by constraining the update, but they do so through fixed projection operators. SafeLoRA projects the update into a safety-aligned subspace defined by reference models @hsu2024safelora, while SaLoRA uses a null-space formulation to preserve more task capacity @li2025salora. Both methods reveal the same structural limitation: safety is enforced by a static geometric constraint rather than by an estimate derived from the current task and model state. This gap matters because hard constraints can be too rigid for downstream learning. If the task update already contains safety-preserving information, then forcing it into a fixed null space or a fixed safety subspace can remove exactly the directions needed for performance. The opportunity, suggested by @meng2024pissa, is to treat the LoRA update geometry itself as the object of analysis: if safety-relevant directions can be identified from the update space, then safety preservation can be enforced through a data-dependent constraint rather than a hand-designed one. At the same time, @aghajanyan2021intrinsic suggests that fine-tuning occupies a low-dimensional manifold, making it plausible that safety alignment can also be represented by a compact subspace. The problem we therefore address is: how can we estimate a task-specific safety subspace from the model’s own behavior, and how can we use that estimate to constrain LoRA updates so that safety is preserved without sacrificing downstream utility? We define the research problem as constructing a safety-aware LoRA method that is adaptive to the downstream task while remaining lightweight and compatible with frozen backbones. The key technical challenge is to estimate a safety-relevant subspace from limited safety-aligned data and to convert that estimate into a trainable update constraint that suppresses harmful directions while leaving task-relevant directions available for learning. [Method] We propose Safety LoRA, a safety-aware fine-tuning framework that estimates a safety subspace from the model’s own safety-aligned outputs and constrains the downstream LoRA update to remain in the null space of that subspace. Instead of projecting the update into a fixed safety-aligned or null space as in prior methods @hsu2024safelora @li2025salora, we estimate the dominant safety directions through SVD and remove only the most influential safety-irrelevant directions. This formulation directly addresses the rigidity of fixed constraints while preserving the low-rank adaptation efficiency introduced by @hu2022lo […]
blocks.zh: 产出: Quen3-8B SFT 软件 思考追踪(摘录): 我从LORA已经为适应提供了强大的结构手柄的观察开始:它冻结了骨干并学习了低级更新,因此任何安全干预都可以被直接插入到更新空间中,而不是完全被微调@hu2022lora. 限制在于更新空间不受限制,之前的安全工作已经表明,即使是良性的下游适应也能降低校正度@qi2024finetation. SafeLora通过使用参考模型@hsu2024safelora将Lora更新投影到安全相通子空间来解决了这个问题,但其投影是一个能抑制任务学习的硬约束. SaLORA改进了该配方,将安全子空间取而代之, 保留了更多的任务能力@li2025salora, 建议:[动机] 微调与LORA对接的大型语言模型具有吸引力,因为它保留了主干并保持了适应轻量级,但最近的证据表明,这种效率伴随着安全成本. 即使是良性下游适应也能降低安全相接,表明LORA更新空间在优化时会向有害方向漂移@qi2024finetation. 现有的安全意识LORA方法通过限制更新来解决这个问题,但它们通过固定的投影操作器来解决. SafeLORA将更新投放到由参考模型@hsu2024safelora定义的安全相通子空间中,而SaLORA则使用空空配来保存更多的任务容量@li2025salora. 两种方法都揭示出相同的结构限制:安全性是由静态几何约束而不是由从当前任务和模型状态得出的估计来强制的. 这种差距很重要,因为硬约束可能过于僵硬,无法下游学习。 如果任务更新已经包含安全保存信息,那么强迫它进入固定的空地或固定的安全子空间可以完全去除性能所需的方向. @meng2024pissa建议的机会是将LORA更新几何本身作为分析对象:如果从更新空间中可以识别出与安全相关的方向,那么安全保全可以通过依赖数据的限制而不是手工设计的限制来执行. 同时,@aghajanyan2021intrinsic认为微调占用了低维多维,使得安全相接也可以由紧凑的子空间来代表。 因此,我们所处理的问题是:我们如何从模型本身的行为中估算出一个针对特定任务的安全子空间,以及我们如何利用这一估计来限制LORA更新,从而在不牺牲下游效用的情况下保持安全? 我们把研究问题定义为构建一种安全意识的LORA方法,适应下游的任务,同时保持轻量和与被冻结的骨干兼容. 关键的技术挑战是从有限的安全相通数据中估计一个与安全有关的子空间,并将这一估计转换为可训练的更新约束,抑制有害的方向,同时留下与任务有关的指示供学习使用。 [方法]我们提议安全线网(Safety LoRA),这是一个安全线的微调框架,它从模型自身安全线的输出中估计出一个安全线网(security subspace),并限制下游的LORA更新,使其停留在该子空间的空地上. 我们没有像以前的方法那样将更新投射为固定的安全相通或空地@hsu2024saferlora@li2025salora,而是通过SVD来估计主导安全方向,只去除最有影响力的安全相关方向. 这种提法直接涉及固定约束的僵硬性,同时保留了由@hu2022lo [.]提出的低级适应效率。

blocks.en: Analysis Gap identification. The SFT model identifies a specific failure mode: fixed safety projection constraints can over-regularize because they treat safety as a static property rather than a task-conditioned geometric structure. The base model identifies a broader “global vs. selective constraint” gap without pinpointing why existing constraints fail. Cross-paper synthesis. The SFT model traces a precise design path: LoRA provides the update space → \rightarrow safety degradation persists even under benign adaptation → \rightarrow existing projections (SafeLoRA, SaLoRA) are too rigid → \rightarrow PiSSA shows SVD can identify important directions → \rightarrow AlphaEdit shows null-space projection preserves behaviors → \rightarrow combining these yields data-dependent safety estimation. The base model mentions similar papers but does not construct a causal chain showing why their combination produces a specific new mechanism. Methodological specificity. The SFT model proposes four tightly coupled steps: estimate safety subspace from model outputs, extract dominant directions via SVD, project LoRA updates into the null space of those directions, and train under this adaptive constraint. The base model proposes “ID-SaLoRA” but describes it at a higher level of abstraction without specifying how intrinsic dimensionality analysis concretely feeds into the safety constraint.
blocks.zh: 分析差距识别。 SFT模型识别出一种特定的故障模式:固定的安全投影限制可以过度规范化,因为它们将安全作为静态属性而不是任务条件几何结构. 基准模式确定了更广泛的“全球与选择性制约”差距,但没有具体说明现有制约为何失败。 跨纸综合. SFT模型追踪到精确的设计路径: LORA提供更新空间 即使在良性适应下也持续存在正中的安全退化 \ 右中线现有预测(SafeLORA,SALORA)过于僵硬 \ 右中线 PISSA显示 SVD可以识别出重要方向 \\ 右中线 AlphaEdit显示空外线投射保留了行为 \\ 右中线结合这些产量依赖的安全估计. 基准模型提到类似的文件,但没有构建一个因果链,表明其组合为何产生出一种具体的新机制。 方法的特异性。 SFT模型提出了四个紧密相接的步骤:从模型输出中估算出安全子空间,通过SVD提取主方向,项目LORA更新到这些方向的空地上,并在这种适应性制约下进行训练. 基准模型提出“ID-SALORA”,但以更高的抽象程度加以描述,而没有具体说明内在维度分析如何具体地促进安全限制。
